name: Ashley Hinson
summary:
Ashley Elizabeth Hinson (born June 27, 1983) is an American politician, and former broadcast journalist, serving as the U.S. representative for Iowa's 2nd congressional district since 2021. A member of the Republican Party, she was a member of the Iowa House of Representatives for the 67th district from 2017 to 2021.
Hinson was a reporter and anchor at KCRG-TV in Cedar Rapids for more than a decade.
